newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint firms vs dlr, weakens vs basket.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint firms vs dlr, weakens vs basket.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended Friday's shorter trading day around 30 pips from the central bank's resistance level as bidders entered the market, traders said.
"It was very biddish today," said Orsolya Liptai of Magyar Hitel Bank. "Quite a lot of banks were bidding strongly (for foreign currency)."
Despite the forex buying, the forint still firmed against the dollar as the mark strengthened against the U.S. unit on European markets.
The forint finished at 168.90/95 to the dollar, compared to its opening level of 169.00/10, while the central bank stood at around 168.60 to one dollar.
Relatively low turnover on the currency futures section of the Budapest Commodity Exchange was dominated by the Swiss franc, with the dollar and sterling also featuring.
The Ecu, sterling and dollar fell for most maturities, while the mark and lira were stable, the yen was mixed and the Swiss franc rose for March, September and December.
